_comment: Wound-cleaning vignette as a directed graph of dialogue states (cycles allowed). Each state is one beat. A state either (a) waits for user input and branches on the matched option, (b) auto-advances to `auto.to` after `auto.after` seconds when no reply is needed, or (c) is terminal. `control` drives the robot; `ease` lowers the current dab force before acting. Edit this file to reshape the procedure without touching the engine.

global._comment: Options available at every input state. 'stop' aborts at any point.

greeting.say: Hello. I'm going to perform a wound cleaning procedure on your forearm. It should take about one minute. Before I begin, how would you rate any discomfort you're currently feeling, from one to five?

consent.say: I'll be gently cleaning the wound area. You can say 'stop' at any time. Are you ready to begin?

begin.say: I'm going to begin now. You'll feel some light pressure.

ease_1._comment: Adaptive response, then re-check the same area: ease_1 -> check_1 is a cycle.
ease_1.say: I'll ease up on the pressure.

move.say: Good. I'm going to move to the next area.

silence._comment: Naturalistic silence: the robot keeps working without speaking.

ease_2.say: I'll ease up on the pressure.

almost.say: You're doing well. Just one more area.

final_check.say: How are you feeling? Any discomfort?

closing.say: If you notice increased pain or redness, contact your care team. Thank you for your patience.

refused.say: Understood. We won't proceed. Take care.
